deploymentState.deploymentNotes: Resolves a mixed-case-class OR instead of refusing it. The store cannot OR a case-insensitive leaf with a case-sensitive one, so the existing pre-pass fetch now carries a case-insensitive SUPERSET of the union, the conditions are applied exactly in memory, and the whole OR collapses to one 'id IN' leaf. Costs the one extra fetch 'does not contain' already paid for. Approved by Nishank Kansara in session.

inputs.code:
def ids = []
if (rows != null) rows.each { r -> ids << String.valueOf(r.id) }
def useIds = ids.isEmpty() ? ['__none__'] : ids
return [payeeIds: useIds, payeeCount: ids.size(),
        filter: [operator: 'AND', filters: [
            [property: 'properties.payeeId',        filter: [operator: 'IN',  value: useIds]],
            [property: 'properties.effectiveStart', filter: [operator: 'LTE', value: asOfEpoch]]]]]
